widget.instructions: Press Play to run the motion; scrub the time slider to inspect any instant.

stem: A driver moving at {{u}} m/s sees a hazard. After a reaction time of {{tr}} s she brakes at a steady {{a}} m/s².
How far does the car travel from the moment she sees the hazard until it stops?

hints.text: Split the stop into the reaction time and the braking.
During the reaction time the speed is still {{u}} m/s.

reaction-distance-ignored.text: During the {{tr}} s reaction time the car still moves at full speed. Add that thinking distance.

missing-half-suvat.text: Check the braking distance: from v² = u² − 2as with v = 0, s = u² ÷ (2a).

dimension-mismatch.text: Check the unit: the answer is a length.

reaction-distance-ignored.front: Stopping distance with a reaction time?
reaction-distance-ignored.back: Thinking distance u·t_r plus braking distance u² ÷ 2a.

missing-half-suvat.front: Braking distance from u at deceleration a?
missing-half-suvat.back: u² ÷ (2a): the 2 comes from v² = u² + 2as.

generic.front: Stopping distance with a reaction time?

accessibility.altText: One lane with a car that keeps moving during the reaction time.
